name: maker_basis_funding_carry
economic_rationale: Perpetual futures trade at a structural funding rate premium (contango) relative to spot index during crypto market expansion. Long Spot + Short Perpetual captures this funding rate cashflow every 8 hours. Capturing this carry via passive post-only maker execution overcomes the taker fee friction that constrained CRYPTO-001, provided legging delay and basis risk are dynamically managed.

execution_microstructure_model.legging_sequence: Perpetual Maker Limit placed at Best Ask. Upon fill, Spot Maker Limit placed at Best Bid.
execution_microstructure_model.taker_fallback_rule: If Spot Maker unfilled after 15 min -> Execute immediate Market Taker Spot order to eliminate delta drift
execution_microstructure_model.captured_funding_rule: Funding cashflow earned ONLY on matched hedged notional active at exact 8h settlement timestamps

control_baselines.pure_taker_baseline: Immediate market taker execution on both legs (10 bps spot + 5 bps perp)
control_baselines.random_entry_control: Position entered at random dates regardless of funding magnitude (N=500 MC)

decision_gates.gate_1_synchronized_fill_rate: >= 80% of entries fully hedged via maker orders without triggering 15-min taker fallback
decision_gates.gate_2_delta_neutral_integrity: Mean unhedged delta exposure duration < 5.0 minutes per rebalance
decision_gates.gate_3_maker_vs_taker_superiority: Maker Net Sharpe exceeds Pure Taker Sharpe by at least +0.80
